name: kolam
description: Turn messy business, product, and technical context into private source-editable diagrams, with an explicit Verified Mode for automatic framework selection and evidence validation.

interface.longDescription: Create private self-contained HTML/SVG diagrams locally, import Mermaid flows, apply brand tokens, or use Kolam Verified for automatic framework selection and server-side evidence validation.
defaultPrompt: Turn this situation into the right private diagram.
Create a grounded SWOT without inventing claims.
Redraw this Mermaid flow as an editorial diagram.
